__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Data source with the pack's metrics

description: Tick time, players, host, database and tunnel of game servers (FXServer), collected from outside the server process by the gameserver-observability pack. Counts only: no series names a player.

links.title: Runbook
links.tooltip: What to do for each alert

panels.description: Up when the game port accepts TCP connections and info.json answers (probes tcp_connect and http_fxserver_info of blackbox_exporter); Down is what the alert FXServerDown waits 2 minutes for.
panels.title: Status

panels.description: Connected clients, from dynamic.json (a count; no player is named).
panels.title: Players

panels.description: Connected clients divided by the player slots (sv_maxclients), both from dynamic.json.
panels.title: Slots in use

panels.description: 95th percentile of the svMain tick time over the last minute (recorded series). Above 50 ms, the thread's timer interval, for 5 minutes fires FXServerTickTimeHigh.
panels.title: svMain p95

panels.description: The build number the server reports in info.json. Empty when the version string has an unexpected shape; the metrics reference explains the label.
panels.title: Build

panels.description: Time since the active build was switched on, from the build textfile that node_exporter reads (written by the fxserver role of the luminare.gameserver collection). FXServerArtifactOld fires after 8 weeks.
panels.title: Build age

panels.description: Restarts in the selected time range, counted as resets of the svMain tick counter.
panels.title: Restarts

panels.description: Alerts of the pack's rules that are firing now for the selected game servers.
panels.title: Firing alerts

panels.description: Pending and firing alerts of the selected game servers; each has a section in the runbook (link at the top of the dashboard).
panels.title: Alerts

panels.description: How long the svMain ticks took: ticks per tick-time bucket of the histogram from /perf/, summed over the selected game servers. Most ticks of a healthy server sit in the lowest buckets; a load spike moves them up towards 50 ms and beyond.
panels.title: Main thread tick time

panels.description: 95th and 99th percentile of the tick time per thread over the last minute (recorded series). The dashed line is 50 ms, the svMain timer interval and the threshold of FXServerTickTimeHigh; svNetwork and svSync tick every 10 and 8 ms.
panels.title: Tick time p95 and p99

panels.description: Ticks per second per thread over the last minute (recorded series). svMain ticks about 20 times a second while its ticks are short; fewer means its ticks take longer than 50 ms.
panels.title: Ticks per second

panels.description: Mean tick time per thread over the last minute (recorded series).
panels.title: Mean tick time

panels.description: Connected clients and player slots (sv_maxclients) from dynamic.json. Counts only: no player is named.
panels.title: Players and slots

panels.description: Whether OneSync is on, from vars.onesync_enabled in info.json.
panels.title: OneSync

panels.description: Share of CPU time the host was busy (everything but idle) and the share stolen by the hypervisor (steal), averaged over all CPUs; from node_exporter.
panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Share of memory in use (not available to new processes), from node_exporter.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: Share of each writable filesystem that is used, counting the blocks reserved for root as used, like HostDiskAlmostFull; the dashed line is its threshold of 85 %. From node_exporter.
panels.title: Disk used

panels.description: Bytes per second received and sent on all network devices but loopback, from node_exporter.
panels.title: Network

panels.description: Up when mysqld_exporter can connect to the database and query it (mysql_up); Down for 2 minutes fires MariaDBDown.
panels.title: Database

panels.description: Statements the database ran per second (global status Queries), from mysqld_exporter.
panels.title: Queries per second

panels.description: Open client connections (Threads_connected) and the limit (max_connections), from mysqld_exporter.
panels.title: Connections

panels.description: Queries per minute that ran longer than long_query_time, from mysqld_exporter; the dashed line is 1 a minute, the threshold of MariaDBSlowQueries.
panels.title: Slow queries per minute

panels.description: Share of InnoDB page reads served from the buffer pool instead of the disk, from mysqld_exporter. Low values mean the pool is too small for the working set. Empty while the database reads no pages at all (0 of 0).
panels.title: Buffer pool hit ratio

panels.description: What /perf/ answers to a request without credentials (probe http_401_expected): 401 is right; a 2xx answer means anyone who reaches the game port can read it (FXServerPerfEndpointExposed).
panels.title: /perf/ without credentials

panels.description: Result of the optional admin hostname probe (job fxserver_tunnel): OK when the hostname answers over HTTPS with a redirect to a login or a refusal. No data without that job.
panels.title: Admin hostname

panels.description: Time until the first certificate of the admin hostname's chain expires, from the optional admin hostname probe.
panels.title: Certificate valid for

panels.description: Edge connections the tunnel connector (cloudflared) runs, from its metrics endpoint. It also counts a connection while it is being retried, so read it together with the admin hostname probe.
panels.title: Tunnel connections

panels.description: How long each blackbox_exporter probe of the game port took: TCP connect, info.json and the /perf/ refusal.
panels.title: Game port probe time

panels.description: Requests per second the tunnel connector passed to its origins, and the ones that failed, from its metrics endpoint.
panels.title: Tunnel requests
